headline: Coverage and held-out splits are as designed and do not explain the chance result; two non-blocking flaws found (sampler pooled depth 2-3 mark is chance-level for a never-unknown model; logic rows carry a +10 point dangling-word cue).
note: findings.md was not written: the environment blocked writing a findings .md file from this subagent. The same content is in the structured output; numeric tables are in tables.txt and the *.json files beside this one.

defects.description: logic_test_sampler: all 533 unknown rows have meta.depth = None (level 0), and score.py skips them in by_depth. The 'rule-first depths 2-3 pooled' rows are true/false only (356 true, 355 false). Constant 'true' scores 50.1%, constant 'unknown' 0%, uniform 3-way guessing 33%. The mark '>= 50%' is chance for a model that never answers unknown; this explains the 23-56% swings in addendum 5.
defects.effect_on_chance_result: none for the gate depth-3 result (gate is balanced thirds); the pooled sampler number is not interpretable as written

defects.description: Logic rows (not placebo) carry a wording-independent dangling-word cue: unknown rows contain a fresh predicate word that occurs once (break_chain). A lookup on (distinct words, singleton words, sentence count) gets 44.6% out-of-fold, 42.5% on gate, 47.8% at gate depth 3 (above the 45% 'proved wrong' line); recomputed from prompt text alone 42.7% OOF.
defects.effect_on_chance_result: none: the models score 31-40%, below the cue, so they did not pick it up; but 45-48% on logic rows would not prove chaining

defects.description: L and P train contexts are not item-paired (0 of 130000 shared); placebo has up to 4 distractors (spec 1-3) and always >=2 facts; gate has 1608 rows not 1600; test_deeper has almost no conjunction rules (2.4% of sentences); capital 'O' never appears in the parent curriculum; 2 of 1600 sampler rows could not be mapped by my sentence parser; sampler unused-item count is tied to the label (V 0.66) but is not visible in the text.
